title: MFP Functional Claim
description: Relational functional claim model for MFPB_FUNCTIONAL_CLAIM_V1. One record per discrete functional statement observed in a source record. Multiplicity-preserving, no binary slot collapsing.

claim_id.description: Deterministic unique claim identifier under scheme MFPB_FUNCTIONAL_CLAIM_V1.

protein_id.description: Entity identifier in mfp_proteins.csv under scheme MFPB_PROTEIN_ID_V1.

source_id.description: Canonical source identifier from source catalog.

source_record_id.description: Source-local record identifier linking to mfp_source_records.csv.

claim_index.description: Zero-based index of the claim statement within the source record observation.

claim_role_raw.description: Verbatim functional role declared by source (e.g. Canonical_Function, Moonlighting_function, canonical_function_bp), or null if unassigned.

raw_claim_field.description: Source-native field name from which the statement was extracted.

raw_claim_value.description: Source-native verbatim functional claim statement text.

claim_assertion_type.description: Normalized curation tier of the functional assertion.

source_go_ids.description: Semicolon-space delimited list of GO identifiers explicitly provided in the raw source record for this claim, or null.

source_go_aspects.description: Semicolon-space delimited list of GO aspects (BP, MF, CC) explicitly indicated by the source, matching source_go_ids order, or null.

source_ec_number.description: EC number explicitly provided in the raw source record for this claim, or null.

linked_reference_ids.description: Semicolon-space delimited list of bibliographic references explicitly tied by the source directly to this claim, or null.

record_reference_ids.description: Semicolon-space delimited list of record-level references provided by the source, unlinked to this specific claim, or null.

raw_file_path.description: Relative repository path to the immutable raw artifact.

raw_row_or_url.description: Locator within the raw artifact (e.g. row:2, line:15, or URL).

extraction_method.description: Identifier and version of the extraction parser method.

claim_status.description: Operational data quality and segmentation status of the claim.

notes.description: Optional technical notes or parsing caveats, or null.
